An old [[human]] '''woman''' lived alongside their [[Unidentified old man (Coruscant)|husband]] in the [[Tomkip Towers]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="WEK" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The old [[Gender|woman]] first appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|''Andor ''Season 2]] episode "[[Who Else Knows?]]"<ref name="WEK" /> released on [[May 13]], [[2025]] as part of the final block of episodes of [[Star Wars: Andor|the series]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> They were portrayed by [[Ingrid Evans]].<ref name="WEK" />
